Canvas: 16:9 widescreen slide, white to very pale blue gradient background with subtle translucent curved wave shapes. Clean SaaS-consulting aesthetic, generous spacing, blue and teal accent colors, rounded cards, soft shadows, crisp vector icons.

Header and title area: At top left, place a vertical blue accent bar followed by the small black headline 「支援実績【事例紹介】」. Below it, add a blue subheading 「多様な業界の大手企業を支援」 and a large bold main title in bright blue: AI導入・AIX支援で\n豊富な実績. To the upper center-right, place a short Japanese paragraph in black: 「製造・金融・保険・製薬・IT・通信など、多岐にわたる業界の大手企業を幅広くご支援してきました。特に『上場企業を中心とした大手企業向けのAI導入・AIX支援』において、豊富な実績を有しています。」

Logo and industry panel: At the top right, show a small abstract blue-and-red circular logo mark and the wordmark Galirage. Beneath it, create a rounded rectangular outlined panel with a small blue pill label 「対応業界」 centered on its top border. Inside the panel, show exactly 6 evenly spaced blue line icons with Japanese labels, separated by thin vertical dividers: 1) factory icon labeled 「製造」, 2) bank building icon labeled 「金融」, 3) hands/heart insurance icon labeled 「保険」, 4) capsule icon labeled 「製薬」, 5) monitor with code icon labeled 「IT」, 6) radio tower icon labeled 「通信」.

Main layout: Bottom two-thirds of the slide contains exactly 6 rounded white case-study cards in a 3-column by 2-row grid. Each card has a soft shadow, a diagonal numbered ribbon in the upper-left corner, a pale circular icon area on the left, a bold Japanese client-title heading on the right, three small rounded tag pills below the heading, and a short Japanese description paragraph. Use alternating blue and teal accents.

Case cards, exact count and content:

prompt_en: A standing statue of Senju Kannon Bodhisattva reminiscent of ancient Japanese Buddhist sculpture. Like a professional photograph of a museum collection, the background is dark and subdued, highlighting the three-dimensionality and texture of the statue. Museum-grade, cultural asset-grade, ultra-high definition.\

title: 赛博朋克女学生空气自行车
author: アニメを斬る！
categories: 游戏素材,动漫 / 漫画,赛博朋克 / 科幻,交通工具,群像 / 情侣
prompt_en: Create a highly detailed cinematic cyberpunk anime illustration of an enormous retrofuturistic air bike flying through a dense vertical megacity at night. The scene shows exactly two riders seated side by side on top of the machine: rider 1 is a shorter schoolgirl with short dark purple hair, wearing a navy sailor-style school uniform with a red scarf, white knee socks, and dark shoes, holding the handlebars; rider 2 is a taller schoolgirl with long straight black hair, wearing a dark blazer school uniform with a red bow, plaid skirt, black knee socks, and dark shoes, sitting close behind/alongside her. Their faces are softly obscured or out of focus, while the costumes, hair, and vehicle are sharp. The air bike is massive, horizontal, and packed with exposed brass and gunmetal machinery: pipes, rivets, pressure tanks, antennae, cables, gauges, vents, mechanical arms, small panels, decals, and glowing displays. Include exactly four visible purple-blue glowing levitation/engine rings: one large circular thruster at the front-left nose, one large underside ring near the front center, one underside ring near the middle-rear, and one large rear-right circular thruster. Add bright electric arcs around the levitation rings and magenta/cyan light spilling onto the metal. The front has a round warm headlamp, red indicator lights, a weathered rectangular cockpit housing, and a dish-like antenna frame above it. Use a dark futuristic Japanese city background filled with towering skyscrapers, deep perspective, rain-haze atmosphere, and many neon signs in pink, violet, cyan, and blue; signs may contain stylized Japanese kanji/kana-like text, including a prominent large pink sign high on the right and smaller vertical signboards scattered throughout. Overall mood: dense, gritty, ornate, maximalist, steampunk-meets-cyberpunk, nocturnal, dramatic low-angle three-quarter view, the vehicle dominating the frame and hovering above the city. Color palette: blackened metal, bronze, deep navy, magenta neon, violet plasma, cyan highlights, and warm amber lamps. Render in ultra-detailed anime concept art style with crisp mechanical linework, cinematic lighting, volumetric fog, and no watermark. Customize the main neon signage phrase as 八咫烏, the rider uniforms as dark Japanese school uniforms with red accents, the city mood as rainy neon night megacity, and the lighting accent color as purple-blue.\

title: 皇家凯旋游行
author: カーブミラー
categories: 游戏素材,海报 / 传单,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,群像 / 情侣,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en: Create a cinematic dark-fantasy royal triumphal procession titled Triumphal Return. A full-body frontal view of two regal riders advancing slowly down a wet cobblestone avenue through a medieval capital city. The left rider is a noble queen or female knight on a white horse, wearing polished silver plate armor, an ornate white cloak, gold filigree details, and braided blonde hair; her face is deliberately smooth and featureless with a soft skin-toned blur. The right rider is a king or prince on a black horse, wearing an immaculate white ceremonial military coat with gold embroidery, medals, braided cords, high collar, white cape, dark curly shoulder-length hair, and a similarly featureless blurred face. The two horses are large and realistic, walking side by side, with elaborate dark leather tack, gold medallions, decorative breastplates, reins, and royal harness ornaments. On both sides of the street, show exactly six prominent armored guards visible in the foreground and midground, three on the left and three on the right, wearing dark steel armor and helmets, some holding spears or standards; their faces are also blurred or obscured. Behind them, dense cheering crowds raise arms and banners. Tall black-and-gold heraldic banners hang from stone buildings on both sides. In the far background, an enormous Gothic palace or cathedral complex rises with many towers, spires, arched windows, buttresses, and ornate stonework. Confetti and flower petals fill the air and scatter across the wet reflective street. Lighting is dramatic late-afternoon sunlight breaking through clouds, with backlit particles, warm highlights on armor, deep shadows, volumetric haze, and a grand epic atmosphere. Use ultra-realistic detail, cinematic composition, symmetrical central framing, low eye-level perspective, 4:5 vertical aspect ratio, shallow depth of field with the riders sharp and palace slightly softened. Color palette: ivory white, black, antique gold, dark stone gray, muted rose petals, and warm sunlight. Avoid modern objects, readable text, logos, or extra main riders. The mood should feel like a victorious royal homecoming after war, majestic and solemn.\

Set the scene against floor-to-ceiling windows showing a dark blue city skyline, scattered building lights, a bright full moon, and a large warm chandelier reflected above them. Use warm candlelit golden lighting with cool moonlit city contrast, refined romantic restaurant atmosphere, cinematic depth of field, detailed fabric folds, glossy wine glass reflections, soft bokeh, high-end visual novel key art quality, 16:9 horizontal canvas, no text, no watermark.\

Use cinematic shallow depth of field: sharp focus on the Temple of Heaven and foreground gate, softly blurred skyscraper skyline in the back, atmospheric pink-purple mist and warm orange light, high contrast, glossy macro photography look, square composition. title: 赛博朋克特工角色表
author: @CIA0
categories: 游戏素材,产品营销,赛博朋克 / 科幻,动漫 / 漫画,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a futuristic anime/cyberpunk character identity board for KAIYŌ, an operative from a covert faction, presented like a clean confidential concept-art sheet.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 white studio background, high-resolution digital illustration, lots of negative space, thin pale pink divider lines, dark charcoal typography with hot-pink accent labels.

Layout: Large faction logo on the far left with the text “CIAO SYNDICATE” beneath it. Top-left identity block with the huge title “KAIYŌ” and small Japanese text “海洋” to the right, subtitle “Operative / Infiltration Specialist,” then six compact dossier rows: Real Name: KAIYŌ; Code Name: WAVE; Faction: CIAO SYNDICATE; Role: INFILTRATION SPECIALIST; Origin: UNKNOWN; Weapon: CUSTOM SMG. Add the quote “THE QUIETEST WAVE LEAVES THE DEEPEST MARK.” in pink below the dossier.

Main subject: Center-dominant full-color illustration of a young female infiltration specialist kneeling in a tense crouch, one knee up and one knee down, holding a compact custom SMG pointed downward. She has long silver-lavender hair with pink highlights, a high ponytail with loose strands, sharp intense eyes, and a patterned tactical respirator mask covering the lower half of her face. Outfit is a layered loose tactical kimono-style jacket over dark undersuit pieces, baggy cargo pants, black knee pads and shin guards, chunky combat sneakers, fingerless gloves, side straps, belts, dangling fabric ribbons, and magenta tactical accents. Lighting and painting style are energetic concept art with angular brush strokes, cel-shaded anime realism, magenta/cyan rim lighting, deep violet shadows, and crisp edges.

Left-side detail panels: Include exactly 3 panels on the left below the identity block: 1) “FULL BODY” panel showing a small standing full-body version of the character holding the SMG at her side; 2) “COLORS” panel with exactly 5 vertical color swatches: pale lavender gray, hot magenta, dark purple, deep teal, and near-black charcoal; 3) “WEAPON” panel showing a side-view compact custom SMG with suppressor, optic, magazine, foregrip, collapsible stock, and a small magenta ribbon tag.

Right-side detail panels: Include exactly 4 cropped head-detail views under the pink label “HEAD DETAILS”: 1) front view with mask and direct stare, 2) three-quarter side view showing high ponytail and mask profile, 3) rear head view showing ponytail and jacket collar, 4) a small additional head crop integrated in the upper cluster if needed for balance. Below them, include the label “TURNAROUND” and exactly 4 full-body turnaround figures: front, three-quarter/front-side, side profile, and back view.

Visual style: Premium game-character concept sheet, inspired by modern tactical anime design and slick sci-fi identity boards, clean editorial layout, thin pink guide lines, subtle gray shadows under figures, no heavy background scenery. Use hot magenta as the main graphic accent and rim-light color.

Constraints: Keep all visible text in English except the small “海洋” next to the character name. Use exactly the counted panels and detail views listed above. Do not add extra characters, logos, UI windows, watermarks, or background environments.\

She wears a classic cream-colored saree with elegant gold borders and delicate pink-and-green floral embroidery scattered across the fabric, paired with a short-sleeved matching blouse. At the bottom left add a tiny handwritten note: “Chennai / is not just / a city, / it’s a feeling.”

Main scene: A lively Chennai street receding into the distance along the seafront. On the right, a detailed ornate Dravidian temple gopuram rises behind old street buildings, covered with many tiny sculpted figures and pastel accents. A large leafy tree frames the upper right. In the far left background, show a red-and-white striped lighthouse near the sea promenade. The road and pavement should feel sunlit, dusty, and slightly wet with loose watercolor textures.

Street elements and exact counts: Include 3 auto rickshaws: one prominent yellow-black auto rickshaw in the lower left foreground driving away, one smaller yellow-black auto behind it, and one tiny distant auto near the promenade. Include 3 curved black street lamps along the road, decreasing in size with perspective. Include 4 visible birds in the pale sky. Include 1 bicycle cart in the center foreground loaded with green coconuts, ridden by a man. Include 1 separate coconut pile or cart on the lower right near the sidewalk. Include 1 filter coffee stall on the right foreground with a vendor, metal tumblers, a chalkboard menu, hanging bulbs, and a wooden counter labeled “FILTER COFFEE” and “STRONG & DEGREES.” Include 4 major signboards: a green bilingual Marina Beach direction sign in the midground, a large Tamil sign above the right-side building, a shop sign in Tamil above the coffee stall, and a dark menu chalkboard beside the stall.

People: Show a small crowd dispersed along the street and promenade, drawn loosely but recognizably. In the foreground include a woman in a cream saree with gold accents walking away on the right, a male coconut seller riding the bicycle cart in the center, and a coffee stall vendor in a pale shirt behind the counter.

Panel 2 is a narrow inset at the top right showing a cropped long-haired girl in sailor uniform holding a school bag in front of her body. Panel 3 is another top-right inset beside it showing the same long-haired girl wearing a beret and glowing cyan glasses, touching the bridge of her glasses with a confident gesture. Panel 4 is a wide middle panel showing the twin-tailed girl close up, raising one hand in greeting; her face is again covered by a larger gray rectangular blur. Panel 5 is a large bottom panel showing a dramatic tilted view of an ornate school gate opening in bright light, with the long-haired girl running or turning toward the viewer and the cyan-glasses girl standing farther back on the right.

Characters: The twin-tailed girl has messy medium-length twin ponytails tied with ribbons, a sailor school uniform with bow, pleated skirt, and shy energetic body language. The long-haired girl has very long flowing hair, sailor uniform, pleated skirt, school bag in one inset, and a composed expression in the bottom panel. The second version of the long-haired girl wears a round beret, glasses glowing pale cyan, sailor uniform, dark skirt, knee socks, and has a mysterious tech-like aura.

The overall style should resemble a polished Japanese shoujo manga page, with expressive poses, delicate hair rendering, dramatic lighting, and clean page composition.

Constraints: Keep the page monochrome except for the cyan glow on the glasses character. Keep the blurred gray face blocks visible on the twin-tailed girl in panels 1 and 4. categories: 漫画 / 分镜,电影感 / 电影剧照,动漫 / 漫画,角色,群像 / 情侣
prompt_en:
A dark, cinematic anime group portrait inspired by The Last Supper, set in a long stone banquet hall at night. Show exactly 11 seated or leaning female characters arranged shoulder to shoulder behind a long table covered with a white tablecloth, viewed straight on in a wide symmetrical composition. In the exact center is a blonde knightly woman in ornate blue-and-silver armor and a royal-blue dress, posed as the visual focal point with both armored arms extended along the table. In front of her sits a glowing golden chalice radiating warm light upward onto the faces and hands of the group. Behind them, three tall arched windows reveal a twilight landscape with a huge tree silhouetted against a dusky sky. The ceiling has dark wooden beams, and the side walls are lined with large shadowy framed paintings.

The 11 characters should feel like a crossover ensemble of iconic anime-style women with varied silhouettes, hairstyles, and fashion. From left to right: 1) a woman in a glossy red skintight futuristic suit, leaning forward with one hand on the table; 2) a dark-haired woman in muted military-style clothing close beside her; 3) a pale gothic girl in a black dress with long sleeves, hands lifted with delicate fingers; 4) a short blonde woman in a loose white T-shirt, casual and modern; 5) a tall red-haired woman in a white shirt standing slightly behind the others; 6) the central blonde armored knight in blue; 7) a black-haired woman in a black dress with gold accessories and a headpiece, raising one finger; 8) a glamorous woman in a red embroidered dress with long black hair; 9) a dark-haired woman in a low-cut black outfit leaning inward; 10) a teal twin-tailed virtual-idol-like girl in a sleeveless outfit; 11) a green-haired girl in a pale patterned dress seated with crossed legs at the far right, holding a wine glass. Keep all faces attractive anime faces, mature young-adult women, elegant rather than caricatured.

On the table, include exactly 11 place settings, 8 visible wine glasses with red wine, several loaves of bread and scattered rolls, plates, silverware, crumbs, and a few metallic goblets or cups. The warm chalice light should illuminate the center while the rest of the room falls into moody shadow. Use painterly realism, high-detail anime illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro, subdued brown and blue ambience with red accents, solemn yet slightly decadent atmosphere, ultra-wide panoramic framing, masterpiece quality.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a side-by-side anime color-variation test illustration of the same cute sailor-girl character concept in an ARIA-inspired canal city setting.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image split into exactly 2 equal vertical panels with a thin white divider in the center. Soft pastel lighting, dreamy waterfront atmosphere, high-detail anime illustration.

Layout: Left panel shows one character seated or kneeling near the canal, facing slightly toward the viewer, holding a tall white gondola-style flagpole on the far left. Right panel shows a second variation of the character in a similar pose, holding a plush mascot. Both faces are intentionally obscured by opaque square censor blocks.

Subject details: Use exactly 2 sailor-girl variants. Variant 1 on the left has mint green long wavy hair, a white sailor beret with blue trim, a small white flower hair accessory, a white short-sleeved sailor dress with blue and gold trim, white gloves, gold brooch details, and a blue ribbon at the waist. She holds a white flag with a blue curved emblem, and a small raccoon-like mascot sits beside her. Variant 2 on the right has pink twin-drill pigtails with large blue bows, a matching white sailor beret with blue trim and a tiny wing-like accessory, a white sailor dress with blue and gold trim, white gloves, and gold ornaments. She hugs a round white-and-brown cat-like plush mascot wearing a blue bow and gold medallion.

Counted visible elements: exactly 2 vertical panels; exactly 2 main girls; exactly 2 opaque square face-cover blocks; exactly 2 mascots, one raccoon-like animal in the left panel and one cat-like plush in the right panel; exactly 1 tall white flag in the left panel; exactly 1 central white divider.

Background: A romantic Venetian/Aqua-style canal city with pale cream and blue buildings, arched bridges, waterfront colonnades, shimmering turquoise water, reflections, distant towers, soft blue sky, and tiny birds. Keep the background continuous in mood but separated by the panel divider.

Visual style: Polished Japanese anime key visual, pastel palette, soft bloom, delicate line art, glossy eyes mostly hidden by the censor blocks, ornate sailor uniform details, cute fantasy maritime aesthetic, high resolution, gentle bokeh and watercolor-like atmospheric depth.

Constraints: Keep both face-obscuring squares clearly visible and opaque, left block in muted beige-gray and right block in pale dusty pink. Do not add readable text except the simple blue emblem on the flag. Avoid photorealism, avoid extra characters, avoid more panels, avoid logos or watermarks.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cinematic classical music poster for BEETHOVEN CELLO SONATA OP. 69, visualizing the opening as music emerging from silence and becoming a dialogue between cello and piano.

Canvas: Wide horizontal poster, 16:9 aspect ratio, dark black background with subtle teal smoke, antique gold highlights, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, elegant museum-exhibition composition.

Layout: Place a large upright wooden cello on the left third, glowing warmly from below and surrounded by gold dust and abstract vertical city-like bars. Place a black grand piano on the right third, lid open, partly fragmented into geometric square blocks, backlit by a large pale cream circular moon or disk. In the center upper area, show one single thrown glove suspended in the air, arcing from the cello toward the piano, with a bright golden trail of particles, curved staff-like motion lines, and thin orbital circles around it. Use many fine vertical gold guide lines, delicate circles, spirals, and abstract musical geometry across the composition. The floor should be glossy and dark, reflecting the cello and piano faintly.

Visible text: Include exactly 5 distinct text blocks. 1) Large title on the upper left: “BEETHOVEN”, with smaller lines below: “CELLO SONATA” and “OP. 69”. 2) Small poetic block on the left: “THE MUSIC IS / BORN IN SILENCE. / IN AN INSTANT, / IT BECOMES / CONVERSATION.” 3) Small movement list below it: “I — ADAGIO CANTABILE / II — ALLEGRO VIVACE”. 4) Tiny lower-left ending phrase: “FROM NOTHING, / MUSIC.” 5) Upper-right poetic block: “A SOLITARY CELLO / THROWS A CHALLENGE / INTO THE VOID. / THE PIANO, / WITHOUT HESITATION, / CATCHES IT. / AND MUSIC / BEGINS.” Add a small monogram at the lower right: “B / 69”. Use widely spaced uppercase serif typography, ivory and muted gold lettering, with “AND MUSIC BEGINS” slightly warmer gold.

The main headline is stacked in huge condensed sans-serif uppercase text reading SHORT-FORM ATTENTION TAX, with “SHORT-FORM” in black and “ATTENTION TAX” in vivid red-orange. Along the far left margin place a small vertical year mark reading “-2024”. At the top left add tiny uppercase text “YOUR ATTENTION. THEIR ECONOMY.” and at the top right add tiny uppercase text “TIME IS LIMITED. ATTENTION ISN’T.” with small plus-sign registration marks near the corners. Beneath the headline on the left, add the subheading “A hidden cost extracted every time you scroll.”

Create 3 numbered information blocks stacked down the lower left side, each marked by a vertical red-orange bar and large black numerals: section 01 titled “WHAT IS IT?”, section 02 titled “WHY DOES IT EXIST?”, and section 03 titled “HOW IT AFFECTS BEHAVIOR”. Under section 01, include body text explaining that the Short-Form Attention Tax is the invisible price paid for consuming endless short-form content and that it is measured in seconds, minutes, and mental energy extracted by platforms designed to keep you scrolling. Under section 02, include body text explaining that platforms compete for attention because attention, data, and profit are linked, and that short-form content is optimized to be instantly rewarding, infinitely scrollable, and hard to stop. Under section 03, include exactly 6 bullet points in red-orange dash style: “Shortens attention span”, “Reduces deep focus”, “Increases impulsive behavior”, “Disrupts memory & learning”, “Drives comparison & anxiety”, and “Creates compulsive usage loops”, followed by a short concluding sentence about reshaping how you think, feel, and act.

In the center-left and lower-middle areas, add supporting editorial typography in mixed sizes: “Attention is the most valuable currency of the 21st century.” with the word “currency” in red-orange; a small stat block saying “THE AVERAGE PERSON SPENDS 90+ MINUTES DAILY ON SHORT-FORM VIDEO APPS.” with “90+ MINUTES” in red-orange; a giant stacked numeric statement reading “16 DAYS” in black with the surrounding text “THAT’S OVER” above and “A YEAR.” below; and a small closing line “TAX AVOIDANCE STARTS WITH AWARENESS.”

On the right half, show a close-up portrait of a human face in black and white, partially cropped, looking forward, with a serious neutral expression. Apply heavy horizontal motion blur, digital smear, scanline-like streaks, and glitch bars crossing the face, especially across the forehead, nose, and mouth. Overlay exactly 5 vertical social-media style interface icons near the center-right of the face: a white circle/profile dot, a red-orange heart, a white speech bubble, a white bookmark ribbon, and a white share arrow. Add a large translucent red-orange circle covering the lower-right part of the face. Include subtle HUD-like graphic elements: a faint circular reticle with a small red-orange triangular wedge near the upper right, a thin vertical measurement scale near the far right edge, a few white square markers, small black and white horizontal bars, and scattered tiny plus signs for layout texture.

At the bottom, place a barcode on the left with tiny coordinate-like text above it, then 3 footer callouts spaced across the width: “PROTECT YOUR ATTENTION. PROTECT YOUR LIFE.”, “BE MINDFUL. BE INTENTIONAL. BE FREE.”, and “RECLAIM FOCUS. RECLAIM TIME. RECLAIM YOU.” Use a restrained palette of black, off-white, and red-orange only. The overall look should feel like a high-end social critique poster, mixing typographic activism, data editorial design, and dystopian tech-noise portraiture, with crisp layout, strong negative space, and print-poster realism.\
